title: Wire migrated master-data print families into the controlled print-template binding catalog
description: Stage 2 completion of ERP-317: the 7 master-data print families (customer/supplier/employee/expense-account/warehouse/product/other-info) already have controlled datasets (master:{familyKey}), immutable presets and ordered field whitelists via ReportConfigurationMasterDataCatalog, but ReportPrintTemplateFamilies still maps them through Master(...) => Unsupported(...) with an empty DatasetKey and Supported=false. As a result the print-template binding catalog and ERP-313 print rendering reject saved SysPrintTemplates for these families, and the print-template:{familyKey} migration-registry entries stay permanently pending (empty DatasetKey -> GetDatasetAsync returns null). Fix the binding catalog to map each of the 7 master families to its master:{familyKey} dataset key and its authoritative ReportMasterDataColumn whitelist (converted to ReportPrintTemplateFieldAlias with the exact same key/title/type order), reuse the existing family menu authorization, and keep the registry/legacy print routes fail-closed. No new controller/designer/exporter, no arbitrary SQL, no schema/seed/migration changes, no secrets/env, no permission expansion; only the print-template binding catalog plus regression tests. This is not an audit-only task: it makes saved master-data print templates actually bindable and renderable through the generic platform.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 7 master-data print families (customer, supplier, employee, expense-account, warehouse, product, other-info) resolves in ReportPrintTemplateFamilies to a supported family whose DatasetKey equals master:{familyKey} and whose field aliases exactly match ReportConfigurationMasterDataCatalog columns in key/title/type order, preserving the existing RequiredMenuCodes/RequiredMenuText and currency/unit semantics.

The print-template binding catalog and ERP-313 render path now accept and validate saved master-data templates against the controlled master datasets (fail-closed on unknown/malformed field aliases, revoked menus and unavailable datasets), and the print-template:{familyKey} registry entries reach at least preset-ready instead of pending, without ever marking parity-passed from declarations alone.

Add/update executable unit coverage in ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalogTests asserting the 7 master families are supported with the correct dataset keys and ordered aliases, denied/revoked menu and alias-injection still fail closed, and existing master-data migration tests keep passing. Run related tests plus the safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalog.cs:90-96 adds Master('customer'/'supplier'/'employee'/'expense-account'/'warehouse'/'product'/'other-info') and :114-115 Master(...) => Unsupported(familyKey, title, UnsupportedReasonMaster) maps them to empty DatasetKey + Supported=false; :35-52 BuildRegistryEntries then derives print-template:{familyKey} entries with the '无受控数据集' semantics so they stay pending. src/ERP.Application/Services/ReportConfigurationMasterDataCatalog.cs:37,58-67,128-178 already exposes the 7 families with DatasetKeyPrefix 'master:' and ordered ReportMasterDataColumn whitelists, but ReportPrintTemplateFamilies never references it. Consequence: ReportConfigurationPrintTemplateCatalog binding and ReportConfigurationPrintRenderService reject saved master-data print templates even though ERP-317 datasets + presets exist.
